name: Shared Confluence Condition Model
principles: Condition definitions are master rules data; active character conditions store only state.
Only deterministic numeric effects are fed into the character modifier engine.
Lifecycle changes occur only when explicitly defined by the condition.
Derived conditions are calculated rather than duplicated as independent active records.
Overrides suppress another condition without deleting its underlying active record.
Physical dice and recovery procedures remain table actions.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: Can't see; visual perception is impaired and normal terrain is difficult terrain.
conditions.reminder: If vision is your only precise sense, Perception checks take –4; visual effects do not affect you.

conditions.name: Clumsy
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value on Dexterity-based rolls and DCs.
conditions.reminder: Applies to AC, Reflex, ranged attacks, Acrobatics, Stealth, Thievery, and other DEX-based rolls/DCs.

conditions.name: Concealed
conditions.summary: Harder to target due to obscuring features.
conditions.reminder: Creatures you're concealed from make a DC 5 flat check to target you; area effects are unaffected.

conditions.name: Confused
conditions.summary: You attack wildly and don't treat anyone as an ally.
conditions.reminder: No Delay, Ready, or reactions. Damage from an attack/spell permits a DC 11 flat recovery check.

conditions.name: Controlled
conditions.summary: A controller dictates how you act.
conditions.reminder: The controller can direct your actions, attacks, reactions, and Delay.

conditions.name: Dazzled
conditions.summary: Vision is impaired.
conditions.reminder: If vision is your only precise sense, creatures and objects are concealed from you.

conditions.name: Doomed
conditions.summary: Your maximum dying threshold is reduced by the condition value.
conditions.reminder: Decreases by 1 after a full night's rest.

conditions.name: Drained
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value on Constitution-based rolls and DCs.
conditions.reminder: Fortitude is automated. HP reduction remains unresolved because the current rule references character level.

conditions.name: Dying
conditions.summary: You are bleeding out and must make recovery checks.
conditions.reminder: At dying 4 you die. Recovery and damage can increase/decrease the value; losing Dying grants/increases Wounded.

conditions.name: Encumbered
conditions.summary: You are carrying more than you can manage.
conditions.reminder: Includes Clumsy 1 and a 10-foot Speed penalty.

conditions.name: Enfeebled
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value on Strength-based rolls and DCs.
conditions.reminder: Applies to STR melee attacks, STR damage rolls, Athletics, and other STR-based rolls/DCs.

conditions.name: Fascinated
conditions.summary: Distracted by a subject of fascination.
conditions.reminder: –2 Perception and skill checks; concentrate actions are restricted. Ends if hostile action targets you/allies.

conditions.name: Fatigued
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value to AC and saving throws.
conditions.reminder: Recovered after a full night's rest.

conditions.name: Fleeing
conditions.summary: You must flee the source as efficiently as possible.
conditions.reminder: You can't Delay or Ready.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value to all checks and DCs.
conditions.reminder: Decreases by 1 when the Round button advances, unless an effect says otherwise.

conditions.name: Grabbed
conditions.summary: Held in place.
conditions.reminder: Includes Off-Guard and Immobilized. Manipulate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

conditions.name: Hidden
conditions.summary: A creature knows your space but not your precise position.
conditions.reminder: You are Off-Guard to the hidden creature; targeting generally requires a DC 11 flat check.

conditions.name: Immobilized
conditions.summary: You can't use actions with the move trait.
conditions.reminder: Forced movement may require a check against the holding effect or relevant defense.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.summary: You can't be seen.
conditions.reminder: Typically Undetected; creatures can Seek and may make you Hidden.

conditions.name: Observed
conditions.summary: You are in plain view to the observer.
conditions.reminder: Stealth can change this state to Hidden or Undetected.

conditions.name: Off-Guard
conditions.summary: Your attention is compromised.
conditions.reminder: –2 circumstance penalty to AC.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.summary: Frozen in place and unable to act normally.
conditions.reminder: Includes Off-Guard; only actions requiring the mind are available as GM determines.

conditions.name: Persistent Damage
conditions.summary: Ongoing damage occurs at the end of your turn.
conditions.reminder: Roll the persistent damage, then attempt the listed recovery flat check (normally DC 15). Damage expression/type entry is a future UI.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.summary: Turned to stone and unable to act or sense.
conditions.reminder: The current rule changes you into an object with special AC/Hardness/HP behavior; not automated yet.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: Lying on the ground.
conditions.reminder: Includes Off-Guard and –2 to attack rolls; movement is restricted until you Stand.

conditions.name: Quickened
conditions.summary: Gain 1 additional action at the start of your turn.
conditions.reminder: The source effect may restrict how the extra action can be used.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Pinned or bound and barely able to move.
conditions.reminder: Includes Off-Guard and Immobilized; attack/manipulate actions are heavily restricted. Overrides Grabbed.

conditions.name: Sickened
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value to all checks and DCs.
conditions.reminder: Cannot willingly ingest things. A retch action can reduce the value after a Fortitude save.

conditions.name: Slowed
conditions.summary: Regain fewer actions at the start of your turn.
conditions.reminder: Action-economy automation is deferred.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.summary: Lose actions as you regain them.
conditions.reminder: Overrides Slowed while active; action-economy automation is deferred.

conditions.name: Stupefied
conditions.summary: Penalty equal to value on Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based rolls and DCs.
conditions.reminder: Also affects spell attacks/DCs; spell disruption flat check remains a table procedure.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.summary: You can't act.
conditions.reminder: –4 AC, Perception, and Reflex; includes Blinded, Off-Guard, and Prone. Wake-up procedures remain table adjudication.

conditions.name: Undetected
conditions.summary: A creature doesn't know which space you occupy.
conditions.reminder: Area effects can still affect you; guessed targeting uses hidden-target procedures.

conditions.name: Unnoticed
conditions.summary: A creature has no idea you're present.
conditions.reminder: You are also Undetected.

conditions.name: Wounded
conditions.summary: Serious injury increases future Dying severity.
conditions.reminder: Ends after specified healing/rest procedures.
